title: Chapter 80 The Real God Of War
content:
Chapter 80 The Real God Of War

Hearing Jiang Bei's words, Lu Daosheng shook his head.

Seeing this, Jiang Bei smiled disdainfully.

"Since you don't dare, then get out. If you don't have the ability in the future, don't say such arrogant words."

The person who dared not connect him three moves is worthy of letting him join the unknown small force.

I guess this guy in front of me is just a person who has never seen the world but has accidentally got some opportunities. He really doesn't know the world is so strong.

On the side, Yu Qingfeng looked at Lu Daosheng and frowned slightly.

Is this the only one with the other party? Is it because I misunderstood?

Alas, too, there are no such many peerless strong men in this world.

Yu Qingfeng shook his head slightly, then continued to taste tea, no longer watching Lu Daosheng.

"Just forget to take your three moves, we might as well do this."

At this moment, Lu Daosheng spoke.

Hearing this, Jiangbei and the others frowned slightly and looked at Lu Daosheng at the same time.

Lu Daosheng continued, "I will take your move. If I take a step back, even if I lose, otherwise, I will win. How about it?"

I originally wanted Jiang Bei to take his own move. Although I could control my own strength so that I would not kill Jiang Bei directly, I thought that the other party would become his subordinate in the future, so I decided to give the other party some face.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Jiang Bei said in a deep voice: "Are you serious? I tell you, I won't show mercy."

It is extremely difficult to take one move without retreating.

Because many top-level strong men can't even catch a single move, let alone take him without retreating, it's almost the same if he doesn't die.

"I'm not afraid, what are you worried about?"

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

Hearing this, Jiang Bei glanced at Lu Daosheng deeply and nodded immediately.

"good."

Jiangbei agreed.

At this moment, Jiang Bei was also a little curious about Lu Daosheng. Could it be that this person is really capable?

Jiangbei was asked questions and his fortune was immediately followed.

Whether it is true or false, you will know immediately.

Suddenly, a force surged out of Jiangbei's body. Jiangbei's entire aura changed dramatically in an instant, and the powerful martial arts aura continued to be reckless.

The name of the God of Martial Arts is indeed true.

Looking at Jiang Bei at this moment, Lu Daosheng nodded secretly in his heart.

"This move is done."

I saw Jiang Beichao take a step forward and then punched him out.

This punch was extremely plain, as if it was soft, but this punch contained all the martial arts beliefs in Jiangbei.

This punch is the way of Jiangbei.

The way of the God of Martial Arts is also the way of invincibility!

Moreover, it also represents the peak of martial arts in countless star fields.

Buzz —

In an instant, all the space touched by this punch was directly destroyed and turned into a terrifying nihilistic black hole.

The power is so great that the entire Wuling Star Domain has noticed it here.

"This is the breath of the martial god. Senior Martial God has taken action!"

"The God of Martial Arts is worthy of its reputation. It's just a breath that makes me feel desperate."

"Oh, I didn't expect that after so many years, there are still people who are ignorant of their lives to challenge the God of War."

At this moment, all the creatures in the Wuling Star Domain looked towards Wushen Mountain.

They knew that it was the pride of their Wuling Star Domain, where the Martial God Senior was.

It is also the object of worship by countless creatures.

At the same time, the other powerful people near the star field also felt this aura and immediately looked over with fear.

The name of Martial God has been suppressing them for a long time.

As long as the martial gods in the Wuling Star Domain are still alive, they will not dare to do anything harmful to the Wuling Star Domain.

You should know that the struggle between the various star fields is extremely fierce.

However, the Wuling Star Domain has been safe and sound for tens of millions of years, all of which is because of one person.

The God of Martial Arts Jiangbei.

Jiangbei has really not taken action for a long time, so the surrounding star fields have become a little unscrupulous.

Even at the borders of the Wuling Star Domain, they are sometimes harassed and provoked.

And now, Jiangbei's aura of attack undoubtedly reminded them of the horror of being dominated by Jiangbei again.

Suddenly, countless forces in the star domain began to converge and became honest.

They knew that this was a warning from the God of War.

And at this time, on Wushen Mountain.

The moment Yu Qingfeng took action in Jiangbei, he waved his hand quickly, and suddenly, a huge energy cover directly enveloped the entire Wushen Mountain.

This move is to prevent the outside world from being affected by this powerful force.

After taking a last look at Lu Daosheng, Yu Qingfeng shook his head slightly.

Even if he takes this move, it is possible to be seriously injured or even dying, not to mention that Lu Daosheng wants to not retreat.

Impossible, it is impossible at all.

At this time, looking at the ultimate fist mark that had hit him, Lu Daosheng faintly stretched out his index finger and pointed forward.

"break."

As the sound fell, the terrifying fist seal representing the will of the martial god suddenly dissipated at Lu Daosheng's fingertips.

The full-strength attack of the Martial God Jiangbei was broken.

And it looks so easy.

At this moment, the scene seemed to be frozen, strange and extremely quiet.

At this time, Jiang Bei was still maintaining the action of punching, and the expression on his face completely froze.

Yu Qingfeng was holding the teacup in his hand and stared at the scene blankly.

Seeing the two of them looking like this, Lu Daosheng just withdrew his fingers and looked at them lightly, with a slight smile on his face.

Bang!

The teacup in Yu Qingfeng's hand fell to the ground and broke into pieces.

And this voice completely broke the silence in the field.

"You, how did you do it?"

Before Jiang Bei opened his mouth, Yu Qingfeng on the side asked first.

At this time, his face was no longer so cold, but full of disbelief.

This was not just as simple as taking Jiang Bei's attack without retreating.

This was an easy way to resolve Jiang Bei's attack, and even he didn't see how Lu Daosheng did it.

Lu Daosheng didn't answer, just spread his hands and then looked at Jiang Bei.

At this time, Jiang Bei was also extremely unbelievable. At this moment, his extremely solid martial arts heart was shaken.

For a while, Jiang Bei's breath became a little chaotic.

Seeing this scene, Yu Qingfeng's face changed slightly, and he hurried to Jiang Bei's side, "Jiang Bei, calm down!"

Hearing Yu Qingfeng's words, Jiang Bei came back to his senses and hurriedly sat cross-legged on the ground.

Suddenly, countless chaotic auras continued to run rampant from Jiangbei's body.

Looking at Jiangbei, whose aura was somewhat chaotic at this time, Lu Daosheng remained silent, but he did nothing.

He really couldn't help Jiangbei.

Because this is what Jiangbei must and will experience, no one can really be undefeated for a lifetime.

If there really is, it is just a frog in the well.

To be able to become a martial god, it is not to have strong strength and a terrifying martial arts realm, but to have a heart that dares to face everything.

Dare to challenge the strong and dare to accept your own failure. This is the real martial god.

Encountering the strong will make you stronger!

If Jiangbei can figure this out by himself, Jiangbei's strength will change qualitatively and take another step forward.

Then, Lu Daosheng walked to the stone table calmly and poured himself a cup of tea.

Well, it's true that this tea is really good.

On the side, Yu Qingfeng had a worried look on his face. Jiang Bei was in some danger at this moment. If something happened, Jiang Bei's fall from the altar would be a small matter. Yu Qingfeng was afraid that Jiang Bei would be entangled by his inner demons and eventually become possessed and die.

This was one of his few remaining close friends.

"Don't bother, you can't help him, he has to rely on himself for this matter."

At this time, Lu Daosheng on the side drank a sip of tea and then said in a calm voice.
